        Sign in to claude.ai to submit your score and appear here.
        How points work
        • 10 for every regular-season win
        • Title: +500, plus 10 for every playoff loss under 12, so a 16–0 run adds 120 more and 16–1 adds 110
        • No title: +10 for every playoff win
        • 82–0: +1,000 · Hard mode: +200
        • Team rating doesn't count, so a better record always scores more. Your best season on each board posts by itself, and you can post any season from its page in your record book.
        One entry per player on each board. Submitting again only replaces yours if the new score is higher. To show a different season, open it in your record book and post it from there.
        Send the code to the game's owner. They paste it in and your run goes on the board.
        Add a friend's score
        To let friends post by themselves: in Share, turn off "Anyone with the link", then invite each friend's email with "Can edit". Anyone else can send you a score code to paste here.

        Every player and stat comes from Basketball Reference (via the open bball-reference-datasets project), regular seasons 1960–61 through 2025–26, the same kind of team-and-decade averages 84-0 uses. Ratings blend PER, Win Shares per 48 and the stat line. Steals and blocks were not recorded before 1973–74. Not affiliated with the NBA or 84-0.
